fields.title: 4. Proposed New Rules — None
fields.md:
The two events are not inputs to the existing proposals ①–⑤ either. Whether the outcome of the environmental lawsuit (preliminary injunction, merits) **actually changes the nameplate GW expansion schedule** can be judged from the GW figures in 4Q26 and 1Q27 earnings (C-2027-1), so it is counted as a milestone without a separate rule (source: `state.rule_proposals_not_applied` · `state.milestones[C-2027-1]`).
